name: Yesenia Lopez
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 7B

items.text: Yesenia Lopez is the Chicago Board of Education member for District 7B, elected in 2024. She graduated from Pickard Elementary and Benito Juarez Community Academy and earned a degree from DePaul University. She works as an executive assistant for the Illinois Secretary of State and was Latino outreach director for Governor J.B. Pritzker’s campaign.

sentences.text: Yesenia Lopez is the Chicago Board of Education member for District 7B, elected in 2024.
She graduated from Pickard Elementary and Benito Juarez Community Academy and earned a degree from DePaul University.
She works as an executive assistant for the Illinois Secretary of State and was Latino outreach director for Governor J.B. Pritzker’s campaign.

items.text: Lopez voted against renewing several charter school contracts and helped pass a resolution calling for tighter oversight. She abstained from voting on a budget amendment that canceled layoffs. She opposed taking on debt for a municipal pension plan. Her priorities include protecting immigrant families and increasing student mental health services. She called for a board advisory panel for noncitizen students.
